membership.title: 10v10AI Premium Membership
membership.description: ⭐Subscribe to get the following benefits (please leave your Dota2 friend ID in the message to auto-activate)
benefits: 💎 Membership points: 1000 points instantly per subscribed month, plus 100 points for your first login each day
🎯 Skill draft upgraded to a pick-1-of-8, with the 2 extra skills more likely to be advanced abilities
🎁 One free reroll for treasure chest item drops
⚔️ Exclusive membership BUFF: +10 attack, +5% spell amplification, +300 HP, +200 MP
🛡️ Respawn time reduced by 5 seconds, buyback cooldown reduced to 2 minutes
🎮 One free reroll each for the starting active and passive skill draft
membership.note: 😊Membership takes effect automatically starting from your next game

manualActive.prompt: Forgot to leave your Dota2 friend ID when subscribing, so membership was not activated automatically? Activate manually:

disclosure.title: Business Disclosure
disclosure.description: According to the requirements of the Specified Commercial Transactions Act, we hereby disclose the following business information.

address.title: Address
content: Provided without delay upon request, please contact us at the email address below

content: Provided without delay upon request, please contact us at the email address below

otherFees.title: Additional Fees
content: Payment processing fee: Fees will be charged according to the payment method

refundPolicy.title: Exchanges and returns policy
content: You can cancel your membership subscription at any time in your account settings
After cancellation, you can continue to use the service until the end of your current subscription period
We will handle special circumstances on a case-by-case basis

serviceTime.title: Delivery times
content: Membership service is available immediately after successful subscription payment

paymentMethods.title: Accepted Payment Methods
content: Note: available payment methods and settlement currency vary by payment platform

paymentCycle.title: Payment period
content: All four payment methods are processed instantly, and membership is activated as soon as the payment succeeds
With the monthly auto-renewing plan, the fee is charged automatically every month and can be cancelled at any time

manualActive.afdianDescription: For users who have purchased but failed to activate membership automatically, you can manually activate it by entering your Dota2 friend ID and Afdian Order No on this page.

success.message:
Your membership has been successfully activated. Thank you for your support!

If it is not yet active in-game, go to Profile → Member and click "Refresh Member Status" to apply immediately.

error.afdianMessage:
Please check if your Dota2 friend ID and Afdian Order No are correct.
If the problem persists, please contact us for manual processing.
error.kofiMessage:
No unactivated orders found.
If you have successfully subscribed, go to Profile → Member and click "Refresh Member Status" to apply immediately.
If it still does not take effect, please check if your Dota2 friend ID and Ko-fi email address are correct, or contact us for manual processing.

panel.title: Steam sign-in required
panel.why: This page reads and changes your Windy10v10AI game data, so we need to confirm it belongs to you.
panel.scope: We only get your Steam ID, the same number as your Dota2 ID.
panel.safety: The button below takes you to steamcommunity.com. Your password is entered on Steam, never on this site. If you are already signed in to Steam, one click brings you back.
